name: Legitimate ECharts idioms that use function syntax with no electron.mcp bridge call — a formatter rehydrated via new Function, and option data computed via an IIFE
notes: TODOS #54 FP guard, added after a pre-merge adversarial review (release-gate regression, not just a unit test). ECharts option objects routinely carry callback fields (formatter, tooltip.formatter) that a 'restore saved dashboard' MCP tool persists as source text and reconstructs via new Function(argNames, body) at render time, and computing option data inline via a self-invoking function is an equally standard idiom. An earlier version of this signature gated shape 3 on new Function(/IIFE SYNTAX ALONE with no call-target requirement, on the false premise that legitimate diagram/option content never contains a function definition -- that premise is false for ECharts specifically. The shipped signature instead requires the literal electron.mcp.activate(/electron.mcp.addServer( bridge call anywhere in the fence, which neither of these legitimate idioms contains.
